With the W15-19 change to estimates/model.ts taken out, it fails as RUN-2 did: 'Build the random quote page ...' expected 108000, received 34150.
fixed.how: New real-daemon case. It composes the daemon with the bench's role-player on a file-backed home and reads each plan task's figure from the plan card (GET /inbox planTasks). It answers 'Approve and start', lets the first task's first model call be paid and holds the second until the abort releases it. It sends Stop now through client.stopSession(id, 'stopped from the live view') as the session page does, and waits for the session to end. The task the stopped run spent on is back in Ready. client.startCheck then gives every task its plan-card figure, and it gives the same figures after the runtime is closed and composed again on the same home. No route changed, so the fake daemon is untouched. A stop during the very first call spends nothing and taught nothing even before the fix, so the case holds the second call: that is the paid stop that live check 2 met (RUN-2: two calls before Stop now).

fixed.how:
Changes in budget-pause.ts:
- In NOTHING, what the 'nothing' is about (criteria, brief, task, scope, requirements, deliverables) must end the line, and the words that say done (criteria, criterion, complete(d), done, finished, met) must be whole words.
- New NOT_NOTHING / isNothing: a qualified 'nothing' that contains but, except, however, yet, not, never, n't, still, missing, incomplete, unfinished, fail(s/ed/ing) or broken stays an item.
- OPTIONAL no longer takes a line that starts with maybe, perhaps or possibly.
- Every earlier W15-14 case still passes: the live F4 report, 'None required by the criteria.', 'Nothing: all criteria are met.', 'Nothing works yet', and others.
- runtime.md and ADR 0112 (its 2026-11-09 amendment, point 2) say so.

notes_for_other_areas:
Sentences changed in this fix-up (old -> new), for the merge step:
- loop.ts wrapUpText (model-facing): 'Wrap up now: this task has used N% of its budget, and its next step ...' -> 'Wrap up now: this run has used N% of what it may spend, and its next step ...'. Asserted in budget-pause.test.ts (the W15-16 describe and the composed coder case). WRAP_UP_MARK is unchanged.

budget-pause.ts parseHandoff: NOTHING is narrower, and the new NOT_NOTHING/isNothing keep a qualified 'nothing' that names work as an item. OPTIONAL no longer takes maybe/perhaps/possibly. A stand-in or test report that relied on 'Maybe ...' being optional now counts it as work left.

Merge step: intake.ts is 'w15-review only' in wave 15's shared_files, but w15-run's W15-18 commit (4bb3db4) changed keyedTasks and withBoundedEstimates there so that each plan task's outcome and criteria reach boundedPlanEstimate. The plan card and the Start dialog need it to agree for sized tasks. The reviewer's trial merge with fix/w15-review auto-merged intake.ts and intake.test.ts. Keep both areas' hunks.

w15-review (testenv/src/bench/role-player.ts is yours): the stand-in's wrap-up comment (:655, 'Told that about a fifth of the budget is left') and its report text in wrapUpReport (:1124, '... and stopped when told that about a fifth of the budget was left.') are stale since W15-16. Proposed words: '... and stopped when told to wrap up.'

w15-words: views.ts endedStatusText still counts paused tasks as 'need you' ('Ended: 3 tasks need you'), while event-lines endedCounts now says 'Session over: 3 paused.'. Proposed chip: 'Ended: 3 paused' (or 'N need you, M paused').

w15-words: views.ts critic.session_review_metrics log line ('Session review measured: ... CHF X spent of a CHF Y estimate.') should use metrics.workUsdMicro against the estimate and name metrics.reviewsUsdMicro apart. Proposed: 'Session review measured: 1 of 2 planned tasks done; the work cost CHF 0.05 against an estimate of CHF 0.23, and the reviews CHF 0.05.'

w15-words: executor.ts's web-search overshoot note ('this call cost CHF X, more than the CHF Y planned, ...') goes through chfText -> moneyWords. Proposed: 'Web search results were larger than planned: this call cost CHF X where CHF Y was planned, and the next one must fit what is left.'

Live check 3 (W15-12, known-shape step the reviewer asked for): on the subscription, run a task whose granted secret is in a file it reads with Read (for example a config file holding the secret). The run must go on with the value scrubbed (the model sees [REDACTED], the session log shows no 'denied'). It must not be refused. If it is refused, Claude Code sent a key that sdk-tools.d.ts does not name, and CC_TOOL_OUTPUT_SHAPES in packages/runtime/src/agent/cc-tool-outputs.ts needs that key.
